description: FlowMatrix-AI marketing sites that have completed the npmjs migration: `marketing-site` plus `npmjs-scope`. The registry override lives in npmjs-scope so that non-site repos (flowmatrixai-org, creative-engine, client-portal, md-reporter) can take the same protection without inheriting the marketing-site grouping rules. Extend THIS preset, not `marketing-site`, once a site's package-lock.json is free of npm.pkg.github.com. See npmjs-scope.json for why the override is load-bearing rather than cosmetic. Sites that still consume a GitHub-Packages-only package (site-generator, checkout-*) must stay on `marketing-site` - npm scopes a registry per SCOPE, not per package.
